chunks: Sa'd ibn 'Abd Allah, from al-Hasan ibn 'Ali ibn Faddal, from Ghalib ibn 'Uthman, from Rawh ibn 'Abd al-Rahim, from Abi 'Abd Allah عليه السلام, who said:
If something appears from the deceased after his ghusl, then wash the part from which it appeared, and do not repeat the ghusl.

key_terms.الَّذِي بَدَا مِنْهُ: the place from which it appeared

ai.seo_question: If something comes out of the deceased after the ritual ghusl, must the ghusl be repeated?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding the deceased after the ritual washing. If something exits or appears from the body after the ghusl, only the affected area is to be washed, and the full ghusl is not to be repeated.
